summary: Enhance your customer service skills with our training focused on empathy and confidence. Learn to manage difficult customers effectively and professionally.
lede: Handling difficult customer complaints gives customer-facing professionals a structured way to manage emotionally charged conversations and guide cases toward resolution. The training develops de-escalation and active listening, complaint investigation and CRM documentation, and service recovery planning with follow-up. It suits service advisors, team leaders, complaint handlers, and customer experience professionals who manage complaints and escalation decisions.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who manage emotionally charged customer interactions, complaint investigations, service recovery, and escalation decisions across contact, digital, technical, and relationship-based channels.
prerequisites: You should bring examples of common customer complaints, escalation categories, service policies, or quality measures from your work environment where available. The exercises use supplied case scenarios and sample CRM data, so confidential customer information is not required. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted sentiment analysis and workflow automation are taught at conceptual awareness and operational application level, not technical engineering level.
